sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Lok Lambert learned this spell from Dante Vale and used it when jumping from the upper levels of the Basilisk House. [Absent Heroes]

After using Hyperstride to jump over a skycraper, Lok and Sophie Casterwill used Featherdrop to quickly drop down and escape two Silent Soldiers. The spell was used unusually to accelerate the fall, instead of slowing it down. [Den vs Harrison]

Lok and Den Fears used Featherdrop while jumping out of a plane on motorbikes. [The Power of Umbra]

Scarlet Byrne and Sandra Lambert used the spell when jumping out of a Scramjet to join the fight against the Blood Spiral at the Spiral Mark. [Lok and the Betrayer]

full_text:
Featherdrop is a spell used to slow down fast falling objects by creating a yellow or red bubble of energy.

== History ==
Lok Lambert learned this spell from Dante Vale and used it when jumping from the upper levels of the Basilisk House. [Absent Heroes]

After using Hyperstride to jump over a skycraper, Lok and Sophie Casterwill used Featherdrop to quickly drop down and escape two Silent Soldiers. The spell was used unusually to accelerate the fall, instead of slowing it down. [Den vs Harrison]

Lok and Den Fears used Featherdrop while jumping out of a plane on motorbikes. [The Power of Umbra]

Scarlet Byrne and Sandra Lambert used the spell when jumping out of a Scramjet to join the fight against the Blood Spiral at the Spiral Mark. [Lok and the Betrayer]
